activity_summary: Your mother covered the basket and told you not to make a host of Bartholomew. Anne said the stiles would be wet. You took the basket and the canvas, and you did not open either in the yard. The two of you set out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the handle and kept both bundles shut.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a speech in the yard, and named the wet stiles.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Covered the basket and stayed behind.

facets.activity: Took the covered basket, the canvas still sewn

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: Do not make a host of her brother.
